comparisonToRun6.conclusion: Source-first authoring removed most unit mutations, but repeated full AST/picker work and timeout recovery made the complete run slower.

browser.productName: Biscuit céréales complètes goût chocolat BN

functionalAssertions: The first launch displays a real project-resource progress animation and message.
The completed progress surface disappears before the catalog is used.
The root contains 14 unique departments and no duplicate strict-path category.
The strict branch renders exactly 22 products.
Category and product names are actionable schema-backed Button labels.
Product detail, bounded quantity, visible Back and breadcrumb return work.
The strict catalog and detail traversal works after browser networking is disabled.
Every visible catalog and detail image has a positive naturalWidth.

hardPoints.name: frontend-svelte-tree
hardPoints.impact: 23.12 minutes, the largest measured authoring bottleneck.

hardPoints.name: flow-app-progress
hardPoints.impact: Three timeouts left runtime work in progress and required recovery.

hardPoints.name: large picker responses
hardPoints.impact: Targeted source inspections returned complete candidate trees and drove very large cached model contexts.

hardPoints.name: frontend build runtime
hardPoints.impact: The Convertigo container uses Node 18 while Vite 8 requires Node 20.19+ or 22.12+; final builds ran on host Node 22.

hardPoints.name: source patch context
hardPoints.impact: One valid revisioned frontend-svelte-code-patch failed context matching and required a full source code-set.

appliedToolingImprovements: Button descendants of typed iterators now require explicit structured sources in flow-app-progress.
flow-app-progress recommends compact depth-2 trees instead of broad depth-8 inspections.
Image supports a portable project-resource fallbackSrc and verifies failed primary media.
Status and Image resolve resources/... against the current Convertigo project without embedding its name.
Lifecycle negations such as !prepareIndex.success generate correct Svelte conditions.
RetailStore campaign acceptance now checks loaded image pixels and removal of completed progress surfaces.
nextOptimization: Cache the parsed frontend document and schema index by source revision, add a compact binding-candidate endpoint that returns only the selected property/source paths, and make code-check/progress cancellation terminate their runtime work.
